name: Average Joes
summary:
You are a Joe, a species known as the Joeziahs. Joeziahs are very interesting creatures, with their incredible strength and their gift that they cannot die!

Average Joes presents a fun, thrilling and exciting gang beast-inspired game, where your main target is to be the very last one standing.
